title: Input symbol at a clamped position
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with Boolean input $y$, and let $p\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $1\le p\le |y|+1$. If the input head of $c$ is at position $p$, clamped to the valid range from $0$ through $|y|+1$, then the symbol it reads is the possibly undefined list entry $y[p-1]$.
hypotheses_covered: The head position of $c$ equals the clamped position determined by $y$ and $p$
